thread:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: multiple containers in gpu-pool-3 are in CrashLoopBackOff due to SIGSEGV in the serving runtime (vLLM custom fused attention).
Alex G: I'm on it, looking at kube events now.
Maria S: seeing repeated OOMs + segfaults across three nodes: gpu-node-7/8/9. Pod logs show `Assertion failed: kv_cache` and `segfault` from fused_attn.so
Raj P: stack trace points at fused attention kernel: `fused_attn.cu+0x4fb2` — could be a bad kernel with recent runtime image 2.1.7
Lee T: any customer impact? Metrics show increased 5xxs for two P50-critical endpoints since ~4456788950
Alex G: yes, customers on Dedicated clusters using model: gptx-l2 show timeouts/failures. Alerting SLO breach risk.
Maria S: attaching quick logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T13:09:10Z] runtime: segfault at 0x0 ip fused_attn.so+0x4fb2 sp 0x7ffc...
[2026-03-15T13:09:12Z] OOM on gpu0: failed allocate 1.2G
[2026-03-15T13:09:13Z] container restarted (CrashLoopBackOff)
```
Raj P: kube events:
```
Warning OOMKilled pod/serve-gptx-abc - Container killed
Killing container with image redwood/runtime:2.1.7
```
Alex G: plan: (1) cordon affected nodes, (2) drain with `--ignore-daemonsets` to move traffic, (3) roll runtime back to 2.1.6-stable for the serving pool, (4) as a quick workaround set `DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1` in env for new pods.
runtime-oncall: I'm taking node cordon/drain. Will coordinate rollout after.
Maria S: +1 to rollback. We should also change autoscaler to avoid rehitting those nodes during rollback window.
Raj P: runtime build team — did anything land in 2.1.7 that could cause this? @runtime-oncall fyi
runtime-oncall: there was an optimized kernel for fused attn (PR #482) that landed in 2.1.7. We suspected a memory boundary issue in large sequence lengths. I'm rolling back the image pool now.
Alex G: commands I'm running:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-7 gpu-node-8 gpu-node-9
kubectl drain gpu-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl set image deployment/serve-gptx redwood-runtime=redwood/runtime:2.1.6-stable -n prod-gpu-pool
```
Lee T: I'm notifying Support: there are ~12 customers with degraded requests, ETA for initial mitigation 10-15m.
pagerduty-bot: @oncall acknowledged the incident. Escalation to SRE lead if not resolved in 20m.
Maria S: after cordon/drain, a few pods rescheduled to gpu-node-4/5 which use older runtime image — they look healthy so far.
Alex G: applying hotfix env patch to deployment:
```
kubectl patch deploy serve-gptx -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","env":[{"name":"DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION","value":"true"}]}]}}}}' -n prod-gpu-pool
```
Raj P: nice, that avoids risky kernel path while we validate rollback.
runtime-oncall: rollback image rollout is at 60%, new pods come up with 2.1.6-stable. Crash loops drop substantially.
Lee T: customer-impact update: error rate down from 12% -> 1.5% in 8m. Notified top affected accounts, support is sending status.
Alex G: still seeing one node (gpu-node-9) with repeated kernel oops and node-level evictions. I'm cordoning it permanently and asking infra to investigate hardware / driver mismatch.
Maria S: we should add a temporary routing policy to avoid gpu-node-9 pool for Dedicated customers until we confirm hardware is OK.
runtime-oncall: agree. Also filing a follow-up to revert fused-attn optimization and add more unit tests for large seq lengths.
Raj P: creating post-incident ticket with logs, reproducer, and PR rollback notes. Assigning to runtime team and infra lead.
Alex G: final checks: monitoring shows latencies back within SLOs, pods stable, no new segfaults after rollout.
Lee T: switching incident to 'mitigated' and moving to postmortem. Marking oncall handoff to Maria for writeup.
Maria S: taking handoff. I'll open postmortem draft and include timeline, mitigation steps, and follow-up actions: revert PR, regression tests, canary gating for kernel builds.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated. Severity: Sev2. Pager cleared.
Alex G: great work team :thumbsup:
Maria S: notes: follow-ups -> infra to check node9 drivers; runtime to revert fused attn and add e2e; release process to add canary traffic and a rollout hold. I'll ping stakeholders.
runtime-oncall: adding runbook update to include DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION env toggle for emergency.
pagerduty-bot: Incident closed by oncall after mitigation verification.
